in_sanskrit.name: Bharata
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Bharata' is derived from the Sanskrit root 'bhru' meaning mountain or hill. The name can also be interpreted as 'rough' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Bharata is the name of the eldest brother of the Pandava brothers and the founder of the great Indian empire. The name 'Bharata' is also the name of the ancient Indian literary epic 'Mahabharata' and the famous Indian state 'Bharat' or 'India'. The name 'Bharati' is a derivative of 'Bharata' and is often used as a feminine form of the name.

in_hindi.name: भारती
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Bharati' in Hindi is derived from the name 'Bharata'. It is a feminine form of the name 'Bharata'. The meaning of the name in Hindi is the same as in Sanskrit - 'Mountainous, Rough, or Strong'.
